original_metadata.title: Freeness of continuous compact Hausdorff group actions on compact Hausdorff spaces is equivalent to algebraic Peter-Weyl-Galois bijectivity
original_metadata.author: Paul F. Baum; Piotr M. Hajac
original_metadata.source_title: Local Proof of Algebraic Characterization of Free Actions
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The proof reduces an arbitrary compact group to finite-dimensional associated unitary-group bundles, then glues algebraic canonical-map preimages from local trivializations using square-root partitions of unity. It establishes an algebraic bijectivity criterion without assuming a Lie group, manifold base or local triviality for the original action, combining topological freeness with finite-isotypic Hopf-algebra structure.

proof_review.note: Complete six-step author proof read. X and G are compact Hausdorff, the right action is continuous, P_G(X) is the algebraic direct sum of isotypic components and O(G) is the matrix-coefficient Hopf-star algebra. The canonical tensor products over C(X/G) and C are purely algebraic. For the hard implication the author builds X_phi=X times_G U(n), proves the pullback matrix-coefficient reduction and explicitly constructs the finite partition-of-unity preimage. Gleason local triviality for the intermediate compact Lie group and Schneider cosemisimple surjectivity-to-bijectivity are named established background. The appendix quantum-group/pullback remarks are not selected.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem1: continuous right action of any compact Hausdorff group G on compact Hausdorff X is free iff can:P_G(X) tensor_(C(X/G)) P_G(X)->P_G(X) tensor O(G) is bijective. No assumption that the original group is Lie or the original action locally trivial; no completed C-star tensor product replacement.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The full original freeness/Peter-Weyl-Galois Theorem 1 and complete six-step author proof are supplied for arbitrary compact Hausdorff groups and compact Hausdorff spaces with continuous right action. Peter-Weyl algebras and both canonical tensor products remain algebraic. The full injectivity/freeness reduction, associated U(n)-space, pullback matrix-coefficient diagram, finite partition-of-unity preimage construction and trivial-bundle inverse are retained. This is a global equivalence, not a definition check or only a Lie-group special case. Gleason local triviality for the intermediate compact Lie group and Schneider cosemisimple surjectivity-to-bijectivity remain named established prerequisites. Appendix quantum and pullback remarks are not selected.
